[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Find All Duplicates in an Array** [LC 442 · Find All Duplicates in an Array](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-all-duplicates-in-an-array/){difficulty="Medium"}

Values live in $[1, n]$, so index $v - 1$ is a reserved parking spot for value $v$. Park every value at its spot with cyclic sort: a spot can hold only one copy, so the second copy of each duplicate is left standing in some other slot, and the slots whose value is not their own are exactly the duplicates.

[Solved in full in @sec-idx-p1-dups.]{.card-link}
